proposal.mixer_type: T-junction (Stage 2 inlet: liquid from Stage 1 outlet + O2 from MFC)
proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan: all liquid reagents pre-mixed in Stream A before Stage 1. O2 (Stream B) introduced only at Stage 2 inlet T-junction after Stage 1 is complete, to prevent quenching of α-thio carbon radical and Ir(II). Incompatible pairs O2/α-thio radical and O2/Ir(II) are enforced by sequential staging.
pre_reactor_steps: Prepare EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v) offline. Sparge with Ar for ≥30 min in a sealed reservoir. Dissolve PMPSCH2TMS (1.0 equiv, 0.1 M), acrylonitrile (2.0 equiv), and Ir(dF(CF3)ppy)2(dtbpy)PF6 (0.5 mol%) under Ar. Load into gas-tight Hamilton syringe or sealed reservoir for Stage 1 pump feed. (Chemistry Plan deoxygenation_required: true; allowed method: pre-degassed solvent offline under Ar.)
Purge all Stage 1 tubing and reactor with Ar-sparged solvent before starting run to displace any dissolved O2.
Confirm Bronkhorst O2 MFC is set to 0 sccm and O2 feed valve is closed during Stage 1 operation. Open O2 valve and set MFC to 1.12 sccm only at Stage 2 inlet junction.
post_reactor_steps: Collect Stage 2 reactor effluent via BPR (KHU-BPR-FIXED-7BAR, 7 bar) into a collection vial open to air — no special quench required (Chemistry Plan quench_required: false). Sulfoxide 4a is stable under aerobic conditions post-reaction.
Discard startup waste: first 3×τ×Q_liquid = ~86 mL (3 × 28.6 min × 0.5 mL/min for combined stages) before collecting steady-state product fractions.
proposal.chemistry_notes:
Two-stage photoredox sequence. Stage 1 (anaerobic): Ir(III) MLCT excited state at 450 nm oxidizes PMPSCH2TMS via SET to generate α-thio carbon radical PMPS-CH2•; Giese addition to acrylonitrile gives sulfide 3a. Stage 2 (aerobic): same Ir photocatalyst in the carried liquid stream, O2 introduced at Stage 2 inlet T-junction, photocatalytic aerobic oxidation of sulfide 3a to sulfoxide 4a via singlet O2 or direct SET. Key design decisions: (1) Single liquid stream A pre-degassed offline under Ar — no inline degasser available. (2) O2 introduced only at Stage 2 inlet to enforce incompatible pair separation. (3) Vapourtec UV-150 450 nm module (KHU-LIGHT-UV150-450, 450 nm measured, 355 mW/cm2, 24 W radiant) is exact match for Ir(dF(CF3)ppy)2(dtbpy)PF6 MLCT absorption. UV-150 max coil volume = 10 mL; selected KHU-REACTOR-PFA-1MM-10ML (10 mL, PFA, 1 mm ID) for Stage 1 within UV-150. Stage 2 uses KHU-REACTOR-FEP-1MM-20ML (20 mL, FEP, 1 mm ID) in KHU manual photoreactor (448 nm, 62 mW/cm2) — FEP transparent, 20 mL within 30 mL manual photoreactor capacity, T ≤ 50°C compatible with 25°C operation with fan at 40°C (slight elevation acceptable for aerobic oxidation). Total liquid reactor volume = 10 + 20 = 30 mL. O2 calculation: 1.12 sccm MFC → 1.22 mL/min actual at 7 bar reactor pressure; gas void fraction 0.71. Calculation warns Da=1.75 (mixing transition zone) — acceptable for photon-limited reaction where mixing is secondary. BPR 7 bar required for gas-liquid system (calculation: 3.3 bar minimum, selected 7 bar to ensure adequate O2 solubility in EtOH/water and prevent uncontrolled degassing; 7 bar BPR is within UV-150 and manual photoreactor pressure limits and pump ratings). Residence time 28.6 min is blended estimate (21× IF); analogies 1 and 2 (Ir photoredox, 30 min and 12 min respectively) bracket this value. Temperature: batch 25°C; UV-150 with additional cooling operates 10-35°C (25°C achievable); manual photoreactor with fan = 40°C for Stage 2 (slight increase acceptable for aerobic oxidation, no temperature sensitivity noted in Chemistry Plan).
Inventory enforced: KHU tubing reactor KHU PFA coil 10 mL, 1.0 mm ID: 10 mL, 1 mm ID, PFA, single.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation (engineering design Step 2): blended analogy τ = 28.6 min, range 11.1-150 min, IF=21×. Analogy 1 (Ir photoredox radical addition, 30 min flow) — chemically similar mechanism and Ir catalyst class, key difference is DMSO solvent vs EtOH/buffer and no gas phase; 30 min directly applicable for Stage 1. Analogy 2 (Ir[dF(CF3)ppy]2(dtbbpy)PF6, identical catalyst class, 12 min, FEP segmented flow) — same catalyst, key difference is no O2 requirement, higher temperature 50°C; 12 min suggests Stage 2 could be shorter. Analogy 3 (450 nm, radical addition, 2.5 min) — same wavelength and mechanism, key difference is non-Ir catalyst and no gas; 2.5 min is a lower bound. Selected τ=28.6 min as calculation blended value, bracketed by analogies. Verified within range 11.1-150 min. Stage 1 liquid τ = 10 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 20 min; Stage 2 gas-liquid inlet τ = 20/(0.5+1.12) = 12.3 min; total inlet τ = 32.3 min. Close to calculated 28.6 min — consistent.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Gas-liquid system in Stage 2 requires inlet/STP basis per universal physics rules. O2 molar equivalents from STP MFC flow only. Stage 1 is single-phase liquid (τ = V/Q_liq = 10/0.5 = 20 min). Stage 2 reported on inlet/STP basis.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Protocol fact: 25°C. Chemistry Plan: temperature_sensitive=false. UV-150 with additional cooling: 10-35°C range covers 25°C. Stage 2 manual photoreactor fan mode = 40°C (slight increase from 25°C; Chemistry Plan notes 25°C but no strict sensitivity). Analogies 1 and 3: 25°C. Analogy 2: 50°C with improved yield — could explore but 25°C is conservative starting point matching batch. No adjustment made.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: BPR REQUIRED for gas-liquid system, minimum 3.3 bar. EtOH bp=78°C, buffer bp=100°C, op T=25-40°C — BPR not strictly required for solvent bp, but mandatory for gas-liquid O2 system. Selected 7.0 bar (KHU-BPR-FIXED-7BAR) — next available above 3.3 bar minimum, well within pump max 42 bar and BPR inventory. 7 bar ensures good O2 solubility via Henry's law, prevents uncontrolled degassing at reactor outlet.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA for Stage 1 (KHU-REACTOR-PFA-1MM-10ML): transparent to 450 nm, max 80°C, max 34 bar — photochem rule: FEP/PFA preferred. PFA chosen over FEP for Stage 1 as it fits UV-150 and tolerates higher T. FEP for Stage 2 (KHU-REACTOR-FEP-1MM-20ML): transparent to 448 nm, max 50°C sufficient for 40°C operation, 20 mL fits manual photoreactor capacity. Analogy 2: FEP tubing for segmented flow photoredox — directly applicable for Stage 2. Analogy 1: quartz 2 mm tubing — not in inventory; PFA/FEP 1 mm is inventory-available equivalent.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Protocol fact: 0.1 M. Chemistry Plan: 0.1 M. Analogy 2: 0.05 M. Analogy 3: 0.05 M. Maintaining 0.1 M as per batch protocol and Chemistry Plan; no reason to dilute as photon delivery is improved by UV-150, and no solubility issues noted. Da=1.75 is borderline but acceptable at this concentration.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Stage 1: KHU-REACTOR-PFA-1MM-10ML (10 mL PFA, 1 mm ID) — largest coil fitting UV-150 maximum 10 mL constraint. Gives τ_Stage1 = 10/0.5 = 20 min liquid residence time. Stage 2: KHU-REACTOR-FEP-1MM-20ML (20 mL FEP, 1 mm ID) — fits manual photoreactor ≤30 mL capacity. Total declared reactor_volume_mL=10 (Stage 1, primary). Verification Stage 1: τ=10/0.5=20 min ✓. Verification Stage 2: τ_inlet=20/(0.5+1.12)=12.3 min ✓.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: Chemistry Plan recommended_wavelength_nm=450 nm. Inventory: KHU-LIGHT-UV150-450 (450 nm measured, 355 mW/cm2, 24 W) is exact match — highest irradiance available flow photoreactor light source. Stage 2 uses KHU-LIGHT-MANUAL-BLUE-448 (448 nm, 62 mW/cm2) — 2 nm from 450 nm, acceptable for Stage 2 aerobic oxidation which is less photon-flux sensitive than Stage 1 radical initiation.
